RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

entered into between M. Dlamini ("the landlord") and the undersigned ("the tenant")
in respect of 14B Marabastad Road, Pretoria, Gauteng.

1. PARTIES AND PREMISES
1.1 The landlord lets to the tenant the dwelling at 14B Marabastad Road, Pretoria,
consisting of two bedrooms, one bathroom, a kitchen and a garden.
1.2 The dwelling is let for residential purposes only and may not be used for trade.

2. PERIOD
2.1 This lease begins on 1 March 2026 and endures for a fixed period of twelve months,
ending on 28 February 2027.
2.2 The tenant may not cancel this lease before the end of the fixed period.

3. RENTAL
3.1 The monthly rental is R6 500, payable in advance on the first day of each month.
3.2 A penalty of R500 is payable in respect of any late payment of rent.
3.3 No receipts will be issued for any payments made by the tenant, and the tenant's
bank statement shall serve as proof of payment.

4. DEPOSIT
4.1 The tenant shall pay a deposit of R6 500 before taking occupation.
4.2 The deposit shall not bear interest and no interest shall be payable to the tenant.
4.3 The deposit shall be refunded within 60 days of the tenant vacating the premises,
less any amounts the landlord considers due.

5. INSPECTIONS
5.1 No incoming or outgoing inspection shall be required or conducted, and the landlord's
assessment of the condition of the dwelling shall be final.

--- page 2 ---

6. ACCESS
6.1 The landlord may enter the premises at any time without notice to inspect it, to
carry out repairs or to show it to prospective tenants.

7. BREACH
7.1 Should the tenant fail to pay rent on due date, the landlord may change the locks and
remove the tenant's belongings and retain them as security for the arrears.
7.2 The landlord may evict the tenant without recourse to a court of law.

8. GENERAL
8.1 The tenant waives all rights under the Rental Housing Act and any other law, and
shall have no claim against the landlord of whatever nature.
8.2 The tenant shall keep the garden in a neat and tidy condition.
8.3 The tenant shall be responsible for the municipal water and electricity account and
shall pay the amounts charged by the municipality.
8.4 No variation of this lease is of any force unless reduced to writing and signed by
both parties.

9. SIGNATURE
9.1 The parties confirm that they have read and understood this agreement.

Signed at Pretoria on this 24th day of February 2026.
